items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... That's too bad, William Gonzalo. You know, it's wonderful stuff to have.

ctx.x: I don't know, I had to look for it.

Well, it's been misplaced a long time. I don't know what happened. I guess it was thrown away. A whole lot of stuff we, well, it didn't have no place. We had a big shed there. We had to tear it down and have a string, you see, and a kennel in there. That's too bad, William Gonzalo. You know, it's wonderful stuff to have. It was, we had some, we had a nice library too, music.
Oh, yeah. They just couldn't keep it all. They had no place to keep it. The date on this picture says February 28th, 1915. Is that right, I guess? That's about it. Let's see.
